title: Construct selected response units and reduce two normalization costs
body:
This construction gives an actual 38-port selected set for the historical response `J=I-KR` whose ordinary block and corrected original-X response are both dyadic units. A union of the specified complete eight-port minors first has both properties at 40 ports. The construction therefore permits a smaller selected set than that restricted class. It does not prove that 38 is the global minimum or reduce every native cost below S40.

The [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b556092ca912bfe6b2d94d754f51f2068d935c89/research/raw-selected-centre-units/PROOF.md), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b556092ca912bfe6b2d94d754f51f2068d935c89/research/raw-selected-centre-units/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json), [decisive replay receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b556092ca912bfe6b2d94d754f51f2068d935c89/research/raw-selected-centre-units/validation/normal/REPLAY.json), and [independent publication review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b556092ca912bfe6b2d94d754f51f2068d935c89/research/publication-reviews/raw-selected-centre-units/REVIEW.md) give the exact scope. **This does not improve the complete kappa calculation.** Routed access, caller exterior phases, owner histories, child hosting, final decoding, recursive precision, and complete supplier pricing remain open.

The general criterion separates two unit conditions. For `RK=14I`, the ordinary block is a dyadic unit exactly when `T=R_S K_S-13I` is. Given that condition, the corrected original-X response is a dyadic unit exactly when `W=I-R_S K_S` is. The actual S38 witness has `det(T)=2^24`, `det(W)=2^12`, and `det(A)=2^-12`. Its balanced backward, diagonal-borrowed backward, and balanced forward words cost 170,446, 171,662, and 171,290 real dyadic scalar primitives. The diagonal-borrowed backward word followed by `A^-1` costs 179,074. Both response inverse orders are checked on all 112 data coordinates. The separate fixed-A,T paired class has extra restrictions and is not a lower bound for arbitrary selected sets.

The package also proves a general short normalization. For a selected principal unit L, first apply `-L^-1` to selected X, then use the changed selected values in the lower shear. It needs neither an ordinary-block inverse nor a full-response inverse. On the retained changed responses, the complete prices are:

| Changed response | Long normalized backward | Short normalized backward | Saving |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Signed S8 | 99,472 | 89,200 | 10,272 |
| Structured S24 | 96,012 | 89,592 | 6,420 |

These complete local words retain `2433 H1 + 724 H2 + 228 H3 + 102 H4 + 20 H5`: 3,507 native children and rank mass 5,073. Prices include the scalar core, physical exchanges, boundary factors, and owned operations. The signed S8 suffix uses no owned field. The S24 suffix uses the existing C0 and restores its query to zero before every reuse and final reset. The full borrowed-Y response and ordered port operators remain explicit.

The old raw S8 backward words are different: they need 16 real division-by-three scans with a separate price and common-grid contract, and their original-X response has nullity eight even after exact division. Their full two-bank word remains invertible. The changed signed S8 words in the table are dyadic and use no odd division. The [odd-grid review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b556092ca912bfe6b2d94d754f51f2068d935c89/research/raw-selected-centre-units/frozen/work/centre-encoding-campaign-20261014/lanes/bridge-review-20261017/odd-grid-a8-review-20261017/REVIEW.md) retains the rational-grid obligations.

The publication base is `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`. Its [selected record](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51/certificates/selected-result.json) names [PR #4470](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4470), with conditional kappa `60403/20000000=0.00302015`. This package uses different historical inputs and proves no transfer to that selected construction.

The consumed core comes from [PR #3133](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3133), pinned at `51eb9c4ee9e4722010d308aa3309e039d3940cc2`; its [source credit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/51eb9c4ee9e4722010d308aa3309e039d3940cc2/research/rank7-coupled-586-588-carrier-fold/README.md) identifies @dcharb78 for the coupled folds and helper endpoints. Jeremy Diviney (@jeremydiviney) supplied the exchange, integration, and verification in [PR #3148](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3148), pinned at `f2927a4b8afcf0701a6b945e14f30de1d94f5176`; its [base](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f2927a4b8afcf0701a6b945e14f30de1d94f5176/research/coupled-carrier-cap740/words/base.json.gz) and [extra](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f2927a4b8afcf0701a6b945e14f30de1d94f5176/research/coupled-carrier-cap740/words/extra.json.gz) payloads match the consumed core. The retained phase sources come from [PR #2588](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2588), pinned at `8cd9dc88e24f062e2ca2fa7f4844a3d3319381fb`. Its [notice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8cd9dc88e24f062e2ca2fa7f4844a3d3319381fb/research/gmx-t74-borrow43-handoff/NOTICE) credits Rohan Arun for native lowering and owner construction and Cinna Davis (@1337isnot1337) for [PR #2226](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2226) borrowing and warp machinery. The [package notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b556092ca912bfe6b2d94d754f51f2068d935c89/research/raw-selected-centre-units/NOTICE.md) retains the full predecessor credit, exact source notices, and Apache-2.0 licenses. All five phase-source files match [primary GitHub readbacks](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b556092ca912bfe6b2d94d754f51f2068d935c89/research/raw-selected-centre-units/validation/PR2588-SOURCE-VERIFICATION.json). Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used; the separate agent reviews are not human peer review or formal-kernel proofs.

Use Python 3.10 or later on macOS or Linux, the standard library, one process at a time, and at least 3 GiB free space. From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/raw-selected-centre-units/reproduce.py --out /tmp/raw-selected-centre-units-normal
python3 -I -B research/raw-selected-centre-units/reproduce.py --optimized --out /tmp/raw-selected-centre-units-optimized
```

Each output directory must be new. Both commands end with:

```text
PASS_RAW_SELECTED_CENTRE_UNITS
```

The [normal and optimized runs](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b556092ca912bfe6b2d94d754f51f2068d935c89/research/raw-selected-centre-units/VALIDATION.md) passed all eight stages; their mathematical receipts agree. The assertion-based witness producer remains assertion-enabled in both modes. A separate reviewer repeated all eight stages from a relocated copy and independently checked the source bytes, S38 Gram identity, unit classification, scalar prices, and suffix order. The native checks cover both providers, 3,036 child classes per provider, 12 serial words, six S38 words and both response inverses, and 18 changed-response words on all 640 input columns plus 91 private zero outputs. Controls reject wrong global phase, helper endpoints, physical factors, Q order, suffix order, and nonzero C0 at reuse. Owned admission permits CLEAR; arbitrary helper restoration is checked separately.

The old complete-minor check uses its own 480-helper core; its prices are not combined with the later 408-helper core. The producer lower-twelve claim and later separator claims are not adopted. No large fixed-pair enumeration, complete historical compiler regeneration, current selected-supplier replay, or complete kappa calculation ran. Python 3.14.7 on macOS was tested; Linux and other Python versions were not. The [open next questions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b556092ca912bfe6b2d94d754f51f2068d935c89/research/raw-selected-centre-units/README.md#open-next-questions) state the remaining mathematical and caller obligations.
